items.title: 27.2.1 Structure-based classification (banawat ke lihaz se proteins ki qismein) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the structure-based classification of proteins (PDF 164-166).

blocks.text: Proteins amino acids ki linear (seedhi) chains hain jo peptide bonds se juri hoti hain. Peptide bond aik amide bond hai: jab aik amino acid ka –COO⁻ group saath wale amino acid ke –NH₃⁺ group se react karta hai to yeh bond banta hai aur aik lambi linear polymer chain ban jati hai. Bohat se peptide linkages se bani amino acids ki lambi chains ko polypeptide chains kehte hain. Har protein ki apni khaas polypeptide chains hoti hain jo us ki structure aur function (kaam) tay karti hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne amino group ko '-NH³⁺' chhapa hai. Sahi likhawat –NH₃⁺ hai: nitrogen par teen hydrogen atoms (neeche chhota 3) aur aik positive charge (oopar +).

Kisi jaandaar mein protein ke complex (pecheeda) kaam ko samajhne ke liye us ki polypeptide chain ki teen-dimensional (3D) shakal jaanna zaroori hai. Proteins ki structure ke chaar levels (darje) hain: primary, secondary, tertiary aur quaternary.

Primary structure: polypeptide chain mein peptide bonds se jure amino acids ki khaas sequence (tarteeb) primary structure hai. Yahi sequence tay karti hai ke protein mur kar kaisi 3D shakal banayega, aur shakal hi us ka biological kaam tay karti hai. Sirf aik amino acid badalne se bhi protein ki banawat badal kar us ka kaam kharab ho sakta hai. Maslan albumin (kitab ke mutabiq taqreeban 400 amino acids) aur insulin jaise proteins theek kaam ke liye apni theek sequence par depend karte hain.

Sickle cell anemia aik bimari hai jis mein khoon ke aam laal cells sickle (daranti) ki shakal ke ho jate hain. Yeh haemoglobin ke ghalat banne se hota hai. Sickle cells khoon ki nalein band kar dete hain aur khoon ki normal circulation (jism mein khoon ka chakkar) bigar dete hain.

blocks.alt: Do amino acids, H2N-CH(R)-COOH aur H2N-CH(R')-COOH; pehle acid ke COOH ka OH aur doosre ke NH2 ka aik H ghere mein hain. Teer dipeptide ki taraf jata hai jis mein darmiyan ka C=O aur N-H dabbe mein 'Peptide linkage' hai, + H2O. Neeche rangeen beads (motiyon) ki lambi lari polypeptide chain ko dikhati hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 27.4: Amino acids ke darmiyan peptide bonds se peptide chain ka banna (kitab ki Figure 27.4 ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Pehle amino acid ke COOH ka OH aur doosre ke NH₂ ka H mil kar paani bante hain; C=O aur N–H ke darmiyan naya C–N bond peptide linkage hai. Motiyon ki lari mein har moti aik amino acid hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Figure 27.4 mein kitab ne dono amino acids par R chhapa hai, lekin product mein R aur R' likha hai. Dono taraf aik jaisa hona chahiye, is liye hamari drawing mein doosre amino acid par R' likha gaya hai.

Secondary structure: jab protein ki chain ke backbone (main chain) ke atoms aapas mein hydrogen bonds banate hain to regular patterns (baar baar aane wale aik jaise namoone) bante hain, jaise α-helix aur β-pleated sheet. α-helix mein hydrogen bonds aik hi chain ke saath saath bante hain aur chain spring ki tarah coil (lipat) jati hai (maslan keratin). β-pleated sheet mein hydrogen bonds saath saath pari chains ke darmiyan bante hain aur folded (tah-dar) sheet jaisi shakal banti hai (maslan resham ka fibroin), jaisa Figure 27.5 mein hai.
Yeh tarteebein protein ko stability (mazbooti) aur flexibility (lachak) deti hain aur us ki poori 3D shakal banane mein hissa leti hain, jo us ke khaas kaam ke liye zaroori hai.

blocks.alt: Oopar: beta pleated sheet ki teen chains pleated (tah-dar) sheet par; carbon, oxygen, nitrogen aur hydrogen atoms aur R group side chains, aur aik chain ke C=O aur agli ke N-H ke darmiyan tooti lakeeron (dashes) wale hydrogen bonds. Legend: carbon, oxygen, nitrogen, R group side chain, hydrogen, hydrogen bond. Neeche: alpha-helix ka ribbon (feeta) jis ke turns (chakkaron) ke darmiyan C=O...H-N hai, aur saath note.
blocks.caption: Figure 27.5: Primary amino acid chains se alpha-helix aur beta pleated sheets ka banna (kitab ki Figure 27.5 ke mutabiq hamari drawing).
blocks.long_description: Helix ke saath note: helix ke chakkar C=O aur N-H groups ke darmiyan hydrogen bonds se thame hain; har chakkar 3-4 hydrogen bonds se agle chakkar se jura hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Beta pleated sheet mein hydrogen bonds (neeli tooti lakeerein) aik chain ke C=O aur saath wali chain ke N–H ke darmiyan hain, is liye chains sheet ki tarah jur jati hain. Alpha-helix mein yeh bonds aik hi chain ke aik chakkar (turn) ke C=O aur agle chakkar ke N–H ke darmiyan hain. R groups sheet ki tahon (folds) se oopar neeche nikalte hain.
Tertiary structure

Tertiary structure protein ki poori 3D shakal hai jo tab banti hai jab polypeptide chain apni side chains (R-groups) ke darmiyan interactions (aapas ke asraat aur forces) ki wajah se mur jati hai. Yeh interactions hain: hydrogen bonds, ionic bonds, hydrophobic interactions (paani se door rehne wale hisson ka aapas mein jurna) aur disulphide bridges (S–S jor). In ki wajah se chain bal kha kar aik khaas shakal banati hai, aksar globular (gol) protein. Yahi 3D shakal protein ka function (kaam) tay karti hai. Maslan enzymes mein active site ki theek shakal hi substrate ko jurne deti hai aur catalytic activity (reaction tez karna) mumkin banati hai. Is shakal mein koi bhi tabdeeli enzyme ki activity par asar dalti hai.

blocks.alt: Baen: beads (motiyon) ki lari jis ke shuru par teer hai, Primary structure: chain mein amino acids ke jurne ki sequence (tarteeb). Peele teer alpha-helix aur beta-pleated sheet tak jate hain, Secondary structure: primary structure ka lipatna ya tah hona. Aage teer helices, sheets aur loops wali mudi hui chain tak, Tertiary structure: mudi hui chain ki poori 3D shakal.
blocks.caption: Figure 27.6: Primary amino acid chains se proteins ki tertiary structure tak (kitab ki Figure 27.6 ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teeron ki tarteeb dekhein: primary structure (amino acids ki lari) mur kar secondary structure (alpha-helix ya beta-sheet) banati hai, aur yeh mazeed mur kar tertiary structure ki compact (gathi hui) shakal banate hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Figure 27.6 mein kitab ne Tertiary structure ke neeche bhi wahi jumla chhapa hai jo Secondary structure ke neeche hai ('is the coiling or folding of the primary structure'). Tertiary structure asal mein muri hui chain ki poori 3D shakal hai (kitab ki apni definition), is liye hamari drawing mein yahi likha gaya hai.

blocks.title: Keep in Mind (yaad rakhein)
blocks.text: Kuch proteins ki quaternary structure bhi hoti hai. Yeh tab banti hai jab do ya zyada muri hui polypeptide chains (subunits) aapas mein jur jati hain: hydrogen bonds, ionic (salt) bridges, hydrophobic interactions aur kabhi disulphide bonds ke zariye.
Tertiary ya quaternary structure banne ke baad proteins ki jo poori shakal banti hai, us ke lihaz se inhein do main classes (qismon) mein baanta jata hai:

Fibrous proteins: in ke molecules lambe, rod (chhar) jaise ya dhaage jaise hote hain. In ki polypeptide chains parallel (saath saath) chalti hain aur mazboot hydrogen bonds ya disulphide bonds se jur kar fibres (reshe) banati hain. Yeh aam taur par paani mein nahi ghulte, mazboot aur stable hote hain, is liye jism mein structural polymers (dhaancha banane wale polymers) ka kaam karte hain. Misalein: collagen (connective tissue), keratin (baal, nakhun, jild) aur myosin (muscle). Baalon ka keratin aur resham ka fibroin fibrous proteins hain.

Globular proteins: agar poora protein molecule gol ya ande jaisa (ovoid) ho to woh globular protein hai. Zyada tar kaam karne wale (functional) proteins, jaise enzymes, hormones aur ghizai proteins, globular hain. Globular proteins par garmi aur pH ka asar jaldi hota hai (yeh zyada sensitive hain). Anday ki safedi garam karne par sakht ho jati hai kyun ke chains ke darmiyan hydrogen bonds toot jate hain aur chains khul jati hain. Isi wajah se doodh ka protein casein lemon ka ras dalne se, jab pH badalta hai, jam jata (coagulate ho jata) hai. Is process ko proteins ka denaturing (protein ki shakal bigarna) kehte hain.
Anday ki safedi globular protein hai.

blocks.prompt: Alpha-helix ko us ki shakal mein kaun thaamta hai?
blocks.explanation: Aik peptide link ke C=O aur usi chain mein chand amino acids aage wale peptide link ke N–H ke darmiyan hydrogen bonds.

blocks.text: Summary (khulasa)

items: Primary: amino acids ki tarteeb (peptide bonds).
Secondary: α-helix aur β-pleated sheet (backbone ke hydrogen bonds); tertiary: R-groups ke interactions se murna; quaternary: kai chains.
Fibrous (collagen, keratin, myosin) aur globular (enzymes, hormones); garmi ya pH se denaturing.
